question: Passive voice of 'They held a meeting very early'.
options: A meeting will be held by them very early.
A meeting was held by them very early.
A meeting was hold by them very early.
A meeting is held by them very early.
correct_answer: A meeting was held by them very early.
explanation: 📝Past indefinite tense এর Passive করার নিয়ম হলোঃ Object + was/were + Verb এর Past participle রূপ + by + subject. বাক্যের অর্থঃ খুব শীগ্রই তারা একটি মিটিং করেছিল।
hints:
📖They held a meeting very early. এই বাক্যকে passive করতে subject কে object করতে হবে + was/were + V3 + by + Object কে subject + extension
এর সঠিক passive হবে - A meeting was held by them very early.
subject: English Language and Literature
